comparison.objective: Clamp a loose printed part upright in a bench vise at a marked height; candidate commissions and locks an adjustable axis damper through repeated physical impact cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Vise task tests bimanual hold-at-height plus knob turning. Candidate tests recessed hex-key insertion, counterholding, setscrew unlock/relock, fine collar rotation, guarded control actuation, and response-based iteration. Shared bimanual tightening is generic.
comparison.success_condition: Vise requires ≥5 N clamping, ≤2 mm height error, and ≤5° tilt. Candidate requires two safe, repeatable ≥0.85 J stops within 12 mm stroke plus relocking and a witness-torque drift test. Candidate does not specify numeric rebound, overload, drift, or locking-torque thresholds.
comparison.reason: The tested ability changes from positioning and clamping a workpiece to tuning and mechanically locking a damper based on observed dynamics; the shared rotation/counterhold primitives do not establish overlap.
